faqs.q: What are Copper Tubes used for?
faqs.a: Phosphorus-deoxidised copper tube (C12200, Cu-DHP) for plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration and condensers: ASTM B88 water tube in Types K, L and M, ASTM B280 ACR tube, and B111 and EN 12451 heat-exchanger tube. It is listed in 37 sizes, 9.53–92.08 mm outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Copper Tubes, such as IH-TF-CU-DHP-0095-089?
faqs.a: Copper Tubes part numbers begin with IH-TF-CU-DHP and then give the outside diameter in tenths of a millimetre and the wall thickness in hundredths of a millimetre. IH-TF-CU-DHP-0095-089 is 9.53 mm outside diameter by 0.89 mm wall, and IH-TF-CU-DHP-0921-254 is the largest size listed. Quote the full part number, or the standard, grade, OD and wall.

faqs.q: What sizes do Copper Tubes come in?
faqs.a: Copper Tubes are listed in 37 sizes, 9.53–92.08 mm outside diameter, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-TF-CU-DHP-0095-089 and IH-TF-CU-DHP-0921-254. The table includes 9.53 mm OD by 0.89 mm wall and 92.08 mm OD by 2.54 mm wall.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Copper Tubes to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Copper Tubes, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: Which tempers are Copper Tubes supplied in?
faqs.a: For Copper Tubes, B111 tempers for copper: H55 light-drawn, H80 hard-drawn, HE80 hard-drawn end-annealed. Where a figure is not listed for a size, we confirm it on the quotation.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Copper Tubes available in?
faqs.a: Copper Tubes are available in these grades: C12200 / CW024A Cu-DHP; C12000 Cu-DLP; C10200 Cu-OF; C11000 Cu-ETP (not for brazed or hydrogen service; not in B111).

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Copper Tubes?
faqs.a: Copper Tubes are made to ASTM B111, ASTM B75, ASTM B68, ASTM B88, ASTM B280, EN 1057, EN 12451, EN 12735-1/-2, BS 2871, IS 2501. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Copper Tubes connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Copper Tubes, tubes are rolled or welded into tube sheets or headers and carried on baffles or supports, so the outside diameter and wall must match the tube sheet drilling. Related ranges are the [Brass Tubes](/c/brass-condenser-tubes) and [Copper Coils](/c/copper-coils) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Copper Tubes be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Copper Tubes on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.

faqs.q: How do Copper Tubes differ from Plastic-Coated Copper Tubes?
faqs.a: Copper Tubes differ from [Plastic-Coated Copper Tubes](/p/plastic-coated-copper-tubes) in its outside diameter 9.53–92.08 mm against 15–54 mm; 37 listed sizes against 6.

faqs.q: How are Copper Tubes shipped, and can they be exported from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We ship Copper Tubes from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.a: Yes, Copper Tubes are held in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the sizes and quantities you need through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What are Plastic-Coated Copper Tubes used for?
faqs.a: Copper tube with a factory-applied plastic coating that protects it in walls, floors and buried runs and colour-codes the service: water, gas or heating. It is listed in 6 sizes, 15–54 mm outside diameter.
